g.text: Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-406 Metal detector conveyor (built frame, used head) · rev B
NEC 430, UL 508A practice; 75 °C Cu; cord-and-plug; 24 V SELV control
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: SUPPLY 120 V 1-ph 60 Hz, cord and plug, 15/20 A bench receptacle (≈ 3.5 A max). The search head A3 has its own cord and receptacle.
L black / N white / PE green
A3 SEARCH HEAD (P1-418): own cord to its own receptacle, so it stays powered and stable;
only its dry relay contacts come into this box (W5). Configure both relays fail-safe (energised = OK).
0V bonded to PE at TB2 (one point)
scan < 5 ms; belt position by timer
B1 / B2: brown +24, blue 0V (TB2), black → input. A3 relays: C ← +24 (23 / 24), NO → X3 / X4.
Pusher: K2 on = M2 red at +24, black at 0V (out); K3 on = reversed (in); both off = both leads at 0V (motor braked).
S0 NC-2 removes +24 S from both relays: the pusher stops dead in E-stop (category 0) whatever the PLC does.
PE: cord green → TB1 PE → PE stud → G1 earth, M1 frame (W1), box door strap, conveyor frame via the gearmotor and leg; < 0.1 Ω stud to frame (ITP).
HOW THE CIRCUIT AND PROGRAM WORK
START runs the belt (Y1 → K1) only if: S0 healthy (X8), STOP closed (X2), lid shut (X7), head healthy (X4), no latch. Green on while running.
Detect (X3 opens): A1 stamps the time; the pack reaches B1 620 mm on (2.3 s at 267 mm/s). The first B1 edge inside the window ±0.5 s is the suspect pack.
A1 stops the belt (Y1 off), waits 0.3 s, extends the pusher (Y2) for 3.9 s + 0.5 s, retracts (Y3) for the same, then restarts if B2 saw the pack enter the bin.
No B2 pulse within 2 s of the push, two detects closer than one pack pitch, or a B1 miss in the window: red + buzzer latch, belt stays stopped; only the QA key S3 clears it.
Head fault (X4 opens), lid open (X7), STOP or E-stop: belt stops at once. E-stop also breaks M1 (S0 NC-1) and the pusher supply (S0 NC-2) in hardware.
Amber flashes every 4 h of run time: test-piece check due (Fe / NFe / SS through the centre). START acknowledges it after the QA check is logged (ITP T12).
Cord SJOOW 14/3 3 m + NEMA 5-15P, gland M20 (P1-459)
Fuse holder 5 x 20 + 3 A fast, pusher 24 V (P1-459)
E-stop 40 mm mushroom, twist release, 2 NC (P1-459)
START push button flush green, 1 NO (P1-459)
STOP push button flush red, 1 NC (P1-459)
RESET key switch 2-pos spring return, 1 NO, QA key (P1-459)
Power supply 120 V AC → 24 V DC 3.2 A (P1-459)
DIN terminals 24 V: +24 x 8, 0 V x 8 (P1-459)
PLC 8 DC in / 6 DC out sourcing, 24 V (P1-459)
Motor contactor 9 A, 24 V DC coil + diode (P1-459)
Relay DPDT 24 V DC, pusher out / in (P1-421)
Gearmotor 1/8 HP 115 V 1-ph, 2 A, thermal protected (P1-420)
Linear actuator 24 V DC 150 stroke, internal limits (P1-421)
Photo eye retro-polarised M18 PNP, light-operate (P1-460)
Photo eye retro-polarised M18 PNP (bin entry) (P1-460)
Reed switch, closed with the lid shut (P1-460)
Stack light G / A / R + buzzer 24 V DC (P1-461)
Metal detector head + control, own 120 V cord (P1-418)
must pulse within 2 s of push
S0 NC-1 breaks the motor line
0 V to PE at TB2 (one point)
W5 → A3 DETECT C / FAULT C
W10 → H1 green / H2 amber / H3 red + H4 buzzer
G2 M20; under the spine to the outfeed leg
G3 M20; shield at the box end only
G4 multi-hole; P-clips on the -y leg
4 x Ø22.5 [.886] through the lid; legend plates under each
glands G1-G5 M20 in the bottom face
2 x DIN 35 rails; wire duct 25 x 40 between
rails; PE stud on the floor
1. Load ≈ 3.5 A at 120 V (M1 2 A run, ≈ 6 A start for 0.3 s; G1 0.8 A). F1 6.3 A time-delay rides the start current and protects the 14 AWG cord.
2. 24 V budget: A1+A2 0.15 A, K1 0.1 A, K2/K3 0.04 A, eyes 0.05 A, stack light 0.1 A, M2 ≤ 2 A while moving → < 3.2 A G1.
3. E-stop is hardware (S0 NC-1 in the motor line, NC-2 in the pusher supply) and also read by A1 (X8) so the restart needs START.
4. Head relays are configured fail-safe: a dead head, a cut W5 or a detect all read as 0 and stop the line. Never jumper X3 / X4.
5. Keep W5 (head) and W6 / W7 away from W1 (motor) and at least 500 from the head aperture; no cable loops round the head.
6. Program P1-406-FW-01 (CLICK) is kept with the plant software; timers come from design.py (belt speed, reject position, stroke).
